sections.Profile:
Buckaroo and Cow Poke , both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1965, are classic electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. Buckaroo is the replay version, while Cow Poke is the add-a-ball variant. Both machines share a Western theme and feature the same gameplay mechanics, including a unique animated backbox where a horse kicks a cowboy.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965–1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
